## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew check apiCheck` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the change (core tests in `commonTest`)
- [ ] Public API changes are intentional and `./gradlew apiDump` was run
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased" if users will notice the change
- [ ] Docs and samples are updated if behaviour changed
